prompt: A close vertical snapshot on grainy colour film, no flash, of a low metal shelf in a cramped British corner shop at night. One loaf of plain white sliced bread in a clear unbranded plastic bag sits alone; the rest of the shelf is bare. A white shelf-edge price label clipped in front of it reads "50p" in black marker. A single fluorescent tube overhead casts a cold blue-green tint, and the back of the shelf sinks into murky shadow. Soft focus, slightly underexposed, dust on the plastic, a crooked handheld frame. Ordinary, cheap, and quietly unsettling, as if the price is a trap. Thanks.
